subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: Should official mobile setup codes grant operator.admin by default once redemption is strictly restricted to the canonical iOS/Android bootstrap identity and an admin-authorized issuer?
rationale: The choice deliberately trades least privilege for one-scan mobile usability and changes the authority of a setup code; tests cannot decide whether that product security boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Keep full default with hard gate
options.body: Retain the proposed UX, but require exact official-mobile metadata and canonical profile validation before any silent approval or administrative handoff.

options.title: Keep limited as default
options.body: Preserve the existing least-privilege default and make full administrative mobile access an explicit operator choice.

options.title: Pause full-access pairing
options.body: Close or defer this direction until a narrower capability model can provide complete mobile functionality without operator.admin.

recommendation.title: Keep full default with hard gate
recommendation.body: Retain the proposed UX, but require exact official-mobile metadata and canonical profile validation before any silent approval or administrative handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged gateway authorization ownership and the current feature direction make steipete the strongest available owner for the security/product boundary decision.
